name: comp-155
title: Radio Group With Descriptions
blurb: Radio group where each option includes a label, sublabel, and description.
description: Radio group with two options (Small, Large). Each option has a main label, sublabel, and description paragraph. Descriptions linked via aria-describedby.
use_when: Selecting between plan tiers, sizes, or other options needing detailed explanations.
avoid_when: Simple binary choices—descriptions add unnecessary complexity.
a11y: Each radio properly labeled and described via aria-describedby. Full RadioGroup keyboard support. Screen readers announce description context.
